clue.text: I'm unfortunately returning the sausage

indicators.note: returning asks for the run of letters made by the two pieces to be read backwards

parts.note: I'm gives its own letters, apostrophe dropped
alas is the cry of someone lamenting an unfortunate turn

explanation.surface: Someone sadly sends back a sausage they did not want.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns the whole run IMALAS back to front.
explanation.definitionFit: The cured, spiced Italian meat is a type of large sausage.

clue.text: Texture of a building

definitions.meaning: the texture or weave of a cloth or material
the basic structure or frame of a building

explanation.walkthrough: 'of a' links the two senses: the term is used for the physical structure of a building.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both woven cloth with its feel, and the walls, roof and floors that make up a structure.

clue.text: It gives one a misty outlook in life

definitions.text: It gives one a misty outlook in life

parts.words: It gives one a misty outlook in life
parts.note: literally, a person whose upper body is among vapour would see only mist; figuratively a dreamy, impractical attitude

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a daydreamer out of touch with reality, pictured as someone seeing through fog.

clue.text: The heartless Rene and I could find it even smaller

indicators.note: heartless removes the central letter of the word The
the letters of Rene and I could find a new arrangement, signalling a reshuffle

explanation.surface: Someone called Rene and a friend search for something tinier still.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' leaves TE from 'The'; 'could find' rearranges RENEI into ENIER; 'and' and 'it' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Teeny means tiny, so its comparative form means smaller still.

clue.text: Result of an amusing case?

parts.note: a legal case in a court of law that turns comic would make the courtroom chuckle

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes merriment among those in a courtroom, the natural outcome of a funny legal hearing.

clue.text: Laird can become a high churchman

indicators.note: the letters of the words can become something else, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Scottish landowner rises to senior rank in the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can' is part of the fodder, not a link: LAIRDCAN rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the Sacred College of the Roman Catholic Church ranks just below the Pope.

clue.text: Counterpane allowed to be placed on top first

indicators.note: first tells us the covering piece comes ahead of the other in the answer

parts.note: to cover something is to place a layer on top of it
let means allowed or permitted

explanation.surface: A bedspread may be laid over the bed before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: A counterpane is a bedspread, the top covering of a bed.

clue.text: Oriental jeans ape ruined

indicators.note: ruined indicates the letters of jeans ape are wrecked and put back in a new order

explanation.surface: A primate has destroyed a pair of denim trousers from the East.
explanation.definitionFit: Japan lies in the Far East, so its people and things are Oriental, a dated term for Eastern.

clue.text: Female warrior going to sea

definitions.meaning: a member of the legendary race of fighting women in Greek myth
the great South American river which runs into the Atlantic

explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to the mythical women fighters and to the river that flows out into the ocean.

clue.text: English copper or French coin

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A choice between an English penny and a coin from France.
explanation.definitionFit: The old French crown piece, a silver or gold coin, carried this name.

clue.text: It could rain hard in a storm on an old hag

indicators.note: in a storm suggests the letters of rain hard are blown about and rearranged

explanation.surface: Heavy rain could pour down on an elderly woman caught out in bad weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It could' and 'on' are links; RAINHARD rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A harridan is a bossy, scolding elderly woman, much like a hag.

clue.text: Tagged another ingenious device

indicators.note: another form of the word Tagged signals its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A clever tool was labelled a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: A gadget is a small clever mechanical contrivance.

clue.text: In a frustrating way I'd come back alone accepting agreement

indicators.note: come back says the letters of I'd return in reverse order

parts.note: I'd gives its own letters, apostrophe dropped

indicators.note: accepting means one piece takes another inside it

parts.note: singly means one at a time, alone
concert means harmony or agreement, as in acting in concert

explanation.surface: A lonely person returns to find a pact frustrating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'come back' turns ID into DI; 'accepting' puts CONCERT inside SINGLY after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Disconcerting means unsettling or upsetting, so the adverb describes something done in a frustrating way.

clue.text: Appear almost to notice

indicators.note: almost means the synonym is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: to seem is to appear

explanation.surface: Someone nearly makes an appearance, just enough to be spotted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the last letter M of SEEM; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To notice something is to spot or observe it with the eyes.

clue.text: Dexterity of the French within one's vision

indicators.note: within says one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: sight is one's power of vision
le is French for the

explanation.surface: French skill at handling things lies within view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' is a link; LE goes inside SIGHT after the S.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleight is skill or nimbleness of hand, as in sleight of hand.

clue.text: Having plenty of free time was certain I had followed the French round

indicators.note: followed means the following material comes after the French article

parts.note: le is French for the

indicators.note: round means the contraction wraps around the other piece

parts.note: I'd is the short form of I had
sure means certain

explanation.surface: Someone at their ease felt sure they had trailed the French all the way round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' puts SURE inside ID; 'followed' places that after LE; 'was' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone of leisure has abundant spare time and no need to work.

clue.text: Where an eastern fellow might be found aboard

definitions.text: Where an eastern fellow might be found aboard

parts.words: Where an eastern fellow might be found aboard
parts.note: read as a man from India on a vessel; really a trading ship of the East India Company

explanation.definitionFit: This was a large merchant ship sailing to India and the East, where a traveller from those parts could be a passenger.

clue.text: Gently tell the priest

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical instruction to play softly or gently
to relate a story is to tell it

explanation.surface: Breaking news softly to a clergyman.
explanation.walkthrough: P stands for piano, Italian for soft, in musical scores; 'the' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A prelate is a senior clergyman such as a bishop, a high-ranking priest.

clue.text: A footnote about a creeper

indicators.note: about here means turned around, so the abbreviation is reversed

parts.note: PS, a postscript, is a note added at the foot of a letter

explanation.surface: A small note at the bottom of a page about a climbing plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns PS into SP; 'creeper' is not a plant but a snake that creeps along.
explanation.definitionFit: An asp is a small venomous snake, a creature that creeps along the ground.

clue.text: Eastern assembly could not be closer

indicators.note: assembly suggests putting the letters of Eastern together in a new way

explanation.surface: A gathering in the East could not be any more intimate.
explanation.definitionFit: Something at the shortest possible distance is as close as can be.

clue.text: It gives one a clearer view of the way ahead

definitions.text: It gives one a clearer view of the way ahead

parts.words: It gives one a clearer view of the way ahead
parts.note: sounds like guidance or insight about the future; literally a car part that clears rain from the glass in front of the driver

explanation.definitionFit: The blade sweeps water from the front glass of a car so the driver can see the road.

clue.text: Secret of going out least

parts.note: something deep inside and private is the opposite of going outside the most: furthest within

explanation.definitionFit: Inmost means deepest within, hence most private or secret, as in one's inmost thoughts.

clue.text: There's a New book in the Old Testament

indicators.note: a new version of the word There's has its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A fresh volume has appeared in the ancient scriptures.
explanation.walkthrough: The possessive apostrophe gives no letter; THERES is rearranged; 'a' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical book tells of the Jewish queen of Persia who saved her people.

clue.text: Apply friction to a discord to be played with a flexible tempo

parts.note: to rub is to apply friction

indicators.note: discord implies the letters of to a are jumbled out of harmony

explanation.surface: Rubbing makes a jarring noise which must be performed at a loose pace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discord' rearranges TOA into ATO; 'to be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubato is a musical direction to speed up and slow down expressively, so music performed that way has a free tempo.

clue.text: Space taken by a friend who is sharing

definitions.text: Space taken by a friend who is sharing

parts.note: room means space
a mate is a friend

explanation.surface: The space occupied by a pal who shares accommodation.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines the answer as well as building it: a friend sharing your space.
explanation.definitionFit: A flatmate or companion who shares lodgings with another person.

clue.text: Do something with letters, so to speak

indicators.note: so to speak signals the word is said aloud and spelt differently

parts.note: the plural of the letter U, written U's, are letters

explanation.surface: Doing something useful with your correspondence, as it were.
explanation.walkthrough: The plural of the letter U sounds like the verb meaning employ.
explanation.definitionFit: To employ an object is to put it to work, doing something with it.

clue.text: Salesman given help is reimbursed

parts.note: rep is short for sales representative
aid means help

explanation.surface: A travelling salesman who gets assistance has his money returned.
explanation.definitionFit: Repaid means paid back, the money returned to the person who spent it.

clue.text: Sweets returned under pressure

indicators.note: returned asks for the synonym to be read backwards

parts.note: desserts are sweets, the sweet course of a meal

explanation.surface: Puddings sent back by a harassed diner.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone stressed is anxious and strained, feeling heavy pressure.
